title: Winter Skincare Routine in India: A Simple Morning and Night Guide
ex: A simple winter skincare routine for India: gentle cleansing, richer moisture, daily sunscreen and a night cream, adjusted for how dry your city gets.
rt: Winter Skincare Routine India: Morning & Night | Mirc Glow
rd: A simple winter skincare routine for India: gentle cleanser, richer moisturiser, daily sunscreen and night cream, plus tips for dry, oily and sensitive skin.
quick: In an Indian winter, use a gentle cleanser, a richer moisturiser on damp skin and SPF 30 sunscreen every morning. At night, cleanse well and apply a pea-sized night cream to the face and neck. Use lukewarm water, exfoliate once a week at most and patch test new products.
facts: Winter air in north and central India is drier, so skin loses water faster.
UV is present all year, so sunscreen is still needed in winter.
Moisturiser works best on slightly damp skin.
Exfoliate once a week at most in winter.
